style: high-energy modern sing-along pop for families, 122 bpm, bright major key, punchy drums and big handclaps, bouncy synth bass, ukulele and glockenspiel hooks, warm friendly male lead vocal with a cheerful group chorus on every chorus, call-and-response, verses light and bouncy, pre-chorus builds with a rising snare roll, chorus explodes with full band and group vocals, short claps-and-stomps breakdown, final chorus modulates up a whole step with the biggest energy, vocals start right away on the first beat with the chorus, no instrumental intro, short punchy ending
lyrics:
[Chorus - full band, group vocals]
Whose tail is this? Swish, swish, swish!
Guess the friend and make a wish!
Long or short or fluffy too,
Whose tail is this? I'll guess with you!

[Verse 1 - light and bouncy]
A tail with a tuft, a fluffy end,
It's the lion, our golden friend!
A tail with a brush to swish the flies,
It's the giraffe, so tall, surprise!

[Pre-Chorus - build up, rising drums]
Peek behind and count to three,
Who is it? Let's look and see!

[Chorus - full band, group vocals]
Whose tail is this? Swish, swish, swish!
Guess the friend and make a wish!
Long or short or fluffy too,
Whose tail is this? I'll guess with you!

[Verse 2 - light and bouncy]
A tail with stripes, black and white,
It's the zebra, what a sight!
A tiny tail that flicks and flaps,
It's the hippo after naps!

[Bridge - claps and stomps, call and response]
Swish your tail! (Swish, swish!)
Wiggle, wiggle! (Wiggle, wiggle!)
Shake it left! (Shake, shake!)
Now shake it right and giggle!

[Verse 3 - light and bouncy]
A thin tail with a hairy tip,
It's the elephant, hip hip!
And Milo's tail is feathers blue,
Every tail is special too!

[Pre-Chorus - build up, rising drums]
Peek behind and count to three,
Who is it? Let's look and see!

[Final Chorus - key change up, biggest energy, everyone sings]
Whose tail is this? Swish, swish, swish!
We guessed them all, we got our wish!
Long or short or fluffy too,
Every tail says hi to you!

[Outro - quick and happy]
Swish, swish! Bye-bye, friends!

meta.title: Whose Tail Is This? Animal Guessing Song with Milo
meta.description:
Whose tail is this? Guess the animal from its tail with Milo the bluebird: the lion's fluffy tuft, the giraffe's swishing brush, the zebra's stripes, the hippo's tiny tail and the elephant's hairy tip.
A guessing game animal song for kids: swish, wiggle and shake along. Ages 2-6.

The Animated Zoo makes gentle, colorful videos for little learners. New videos every day! Made with care for ages 2-6. Characters and visuals are animated with the help of AI tools and reviewed for kid safety before publishing.
